Name: AutoPetter
Author: BrogioMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/kEy5S4s.png[/img]﻿[/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Ca6IWya.png[/img]
[size=2]The AutoPetter mod automatically pets your farm animals and pets in Stardew Valley. No more running around to each animal to show them some love—this mod does it for you, ensuring your animals stay happy and produce the best quality goods.[/size]

[size=5][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/BicHKB9.png[/img]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][b]Automatically pet farm animals[/b]: Ensures that all your farm animals are petted every day, maximizing their affection and productivity.
[*][b]Automatically pet pets[/b]: Ensures that your pet is petted every day, contributing to your pet's happiness.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/iE9Ej8s.png[/img]
[size=2]The mod includes a configuration file ([/size][code][size=2]config.json[/size]
[/code][size=2]) that is generated upon the first launch. You can adjust the following options:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2][b]PetAnimals [/b](default: [/size][code][size=2]true[/size][/code][size=2]): Automatically pet farm animals.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]PetPets [/b](default: [/size][code][size=2]true[/size][/code][size=2]): Automatically pet your cat or dog.[/size]
[/list][size=2]If you have the[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [/b]mod installed, you can configure [/size][code][size=2]AutoPetter[/size][/code][size=2] directly from the game’s main menu:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2][b]Pet Animals[/b]: Toggle whether to automatically pet farm animals.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Pet Pets[/b]: Toggle whether to automatically pet your pets.[/size]
[/list][size=5][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/CdNMZ4W.png[/img]
[/b][/size]Simply install the mod and let it do its magic! Every morning, all your farm animals and pets will be automatically petted, freeing you to focus on other tasks around the farm.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GL5VDRA.png[/img]
[size=2]If you encounter any issues, please report them on the[/size][b] [/b][url=https://github.com/brog-io/AutoPetter/issues]GitHub Issues[/url][size=2] page, or the mod’s Nexus Mods page. Be sure to include your SMAPI log and details about your setup.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eiQiXvW.png[/img]
